composition_policy: Full border strips and distinct selected sorts are separately identified. Mixed rows retain all their shapes as complete strips; a repeated motif is not treated as a newly invented sort. The title frame is represented by its corner and border pieces; an autograph crosses the full frame.
excluded_content: Ordinary alphabets and numerals, promotional sample text inside cards, headings and prices, blank versos, bindings, handwriting and scan damage.

credits.note: Signature retained in the engraving; no biographical identification inferred.
Visible drawing/engraving credits retained; no unsupported first names supplied.
